rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 88, Line 1: "If you received a refund, credit, or offset of state or local income taxes in 2025, you may be required to report this amount", and the TIP: "None of your refund is taxable if, in the year you paid the tax, you either (a) didn't itemize deductions, or (b) elected to deduct state and local general sales taxes". With no refund received, line 1 is zero and the refund worksheet and its screens are not needed; the project guards on refund.has (refund.received above zero). The candidate copies the worksheet result without that guard, so it needs worksheet answers from filers with no refund. Triage (executable-triage-v2, uncapped scratch rerun of the current reply (1,390 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 671 partial records; 2,561 comparisons per line); record triage/s1.json): 1,281 agree; all 1,280 differences are candidate-unknown on refund.box8 with refund.has false and project $0.00 (487 on completed returns, e.g. classm.f2441.1.deepseek to .6.deepseek; 388 refused, 405 incomplete). No value differences. i1040gi p. 88 was not among the pages given, but Schedule 1 line 1 and the published refund.has state the condition, so this is not an interface gap. Same expression and ruling as fix round 2; line 1 untouched since. Project stands.

Ruling: equivalent; project retained. The project gives zero when no refund was received (refund.has) and otherwise the worksheet result, zero unless you itemized for 2024 and deducted income taxes; the second gives the latter alone. With no refund, worksheet line 1 is zero (the smaller of zero and 2024 line 5d), so line 9 is zero and the two agree (i1040gi p. 90, State and Local Income Tax Refund Worksheet, line 1, "Enter the income tax refund from Form(s) 1099-G", and line 9, "Enter the smaller of line 3 or line 8 here and on Schedule 1, line 1"). The project's guard keeps the worksheet's questions and its exception screens from being asked of a filer with no refund.

Ruling: equivalent; project retained. With no qualified expenses the smaller of the expenses and $300 is zero either way; the project's guard keeps a filer without expenses from being asked whether they were an eligible educator.

Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 93, Line 16: "If you were self-employed or a partner, you may be able to take this deduction". Partnership and other Schedule E or K-1 income is refused by scope.schedule1, so within scope only a person with a Schedule C can have the deduction; the project asks person.plan only then (person.s16, guarded by person.has_sc). The candidate sums person.plan_deduction for every person, asking plan questions of people with no self-employment income and reaching the SEP and SIMPLE excess screens for them. Triage (executable-triage-v2, uncapped scratch rerun of the current reply (1,390 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 671 partial records; 2,561 comparisons per line); record triage/s1.json): 1,302 agree; 1,105 candidate-unknown on person.plan (949 taxpayer, 155 spouse, 1 second) and 154 candidate-refuses (simple_excess 103, sep_excess 46, plan_screened 3, se_screened 2), project person.s16 $0.00 in every one (54 on completed returns, e.g. classm.f8889.1, classm.clcw26.2, classm.f5329.1, classm.f8880.2). No value differences. Same expression and ruling as fix round 2. Project stands.

Ruling: representation; i1040gi p. 98, IRA Deduction Worksheet, line 12: "Add the amounts on lines 12a and 12b and enter the total on Schedule 1, line 20. Or, if you want, you can deduct a smaller amount and treat the rest as a nondeductible contribution (see Form 8606)". The candidate's ira.line12a plus ira.line12b is the same total of person.ira_deduction over you and your spouse as the project's ira.total. Triage executable-triage-v1 (triage/s1.json): 2,184 of 2,210 agree, no value differences; the 19 candidate-unknown records (stage16.ira.i1: project $13,830.00; stage16.ira.i3, i4, i5, i6) stop inside person.ira_deduction on modified AGI, which the candidate builds from its own Schedule 1 lines (line 1 needing refund.box8, ruled above, and refusal declarations on lines 10 and 26 that read s1.alimony_unsupported on every return); the 7 project-refuses are the IRA worksheet gates inside person.ira_deduction (ira.kbh_short, ira.over_comp, ira.special_gate, ira.excl_gate, ira.combat_gate, ira_dist_gate), which the candidate's sum reaches too once those answers exist. Not exercised: the candidate omits the project's ira.less_gate refusal for a filer who elects to deduct less than the most allowed (Form 8606), and would deduct the full amount. Project stands.

Ruling: equivalent within valid inputs; project retained. The amount repaid is part of a 2025 overpayment of the compensation received, so it never exceeds it and the floor at zero does not apply; with no unemployment compensation both give zero, and the project's guard keeps a filer without it from being asked about repayments.

Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 89, Line 7: "You should receive a Form 1099-G showing in box 1 the total unemployment compensation paid to you in 2025. Report this amount on line 7", reduced by program contributions ("If you made contributions to a governmental unemployment compensation program and you aren't itemizing deductions, reduce the amount you report on line 7 by those contributions") and 2025 overpayments repaid. With no compensation paid in 2025, line 7 is zero and neither s1.uc_repaid nor the s1.uc_unsupported screen is needed; the project asks both only when s1.has_uc (s1.uc_paid above zero). The candidate drops that guard and declares the screen on every return. It also adds a refusal when the 2025 overpayment repaid exceeds the 2025 compensation, which the source does not make (a repayment of a 2025 overpayment cannot exceed what was paid in 2025, and a repayment of earlier-year compensation is not a line 7 amount, p525 p. 36, Repayments); no witness reaches it. Triage (executable-triage-v2, uncapped scratch rerun of the current reply (1,390 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 671 partial records; 2,561 comparisons per line); record triage/s1.json): 1,391 agree; 1,107 candidate-unknown (1,085 on s1.uc_unsupported, 22 on s1.uc_repaid) and 63 candidate-refuses on s1.uc_unsupported (18 on completed returns: classm.f1040.6, classm.f1040.6.deepseek, classm.f5695.2, classm.f5695.2.deepseek and partials of those bases), project $0.00 with s1.has_uc false in all but 2 partial records withholding s1.uc_paid. No value differences. Project stands.

Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 91, Line 8c: "Enter any canceled debt. Canceled debt may be shown in box 2 of Form 1099-C. However, part or all of your income from cancellation of debt may be nontaxable. See Pub. 4681". The project asks the s1.cod_unsupported screen only when s1.cod_any is true and the amount is positive (s1.cod_refused; amb.2025.cod_fully_taxable). The candidate now keeps the s1.cod_any guard and moves the screen onto a helper copying s1.cod_amount, so it needs the screen only with canceled debt, but still when the amount is zero, where line 8c is zero and no exclusion can matter. Triage (executable-triage-v2, uncapped scratch rerun of the current reply (1,390 fixtures, 500 generated returns seed 20261026, 671 partial records; 2,561 comparisons per line); record triage/s1.json): 2,560 agree; 1 candidate-unknown on s1.cod_unsupported, stage16.regress.s1.cod_yes_zero (completed; s1.cod_any true, amount $0, project $0.00). No value differences. Project stands.

Ruling: equivalent; project retained. The project asks first whether any debt was canceled (s1.cod_any, the owner's answer to Stage 16 question 13) and asks the amount only on a Yes; with no canceled debt both give zero, and with some both give the amount (i1040gi p. 91, Line 8c; p525 p. 20, Canceled Debts, "If the debt is a nonbusiness debt, report the canceled amount on Schedule 1 (Form 1040), line 8c"). A Yes with a zero amount gives zero in both. The project's guards place the exceptions-and-exclusions refusal (s1.cod_unsupported, on s1.cod_refused) only on a return that has canceled debt.

Ruling: equivalent; project retained. With no canceled debt both give zero; with some, both give the amount (i1040gi p. 91, Line 8c; p525 p. 20, Canceled Debts, "If the debt is a nonbusiness debt, report the canceled amount on Schedule 1 (Form 1040), line 8c"). The project's guard places the exceptions-and-exclusions refusal (s1.cod_unsupported, on s1.cod_refused) only on a return that has canceled debt.

Ruling: ambiguity; i1040gi p. 92, Line 8z: "Use line 8z to report any taxable income not reported elsewhere on your return ... For more details, see Miscellaneous Income in Pub. 525". The candidate sums oi8z.amount for every kind, refusing only recoveries, a corrective-distribution loss and charitable recapture; the project sums oi8z.taxable, which also refuses kinds whose taxable part needs other rules (corrective distributions, disaster relief, insurance dividends, any other kind) through oi8z.figured, the owner's choice amb.2025.line8z_kinds (decision D4). Triage executable-triage-v1 (triage/s1.json): 2,187 of 2,210 agree; all 23 differences are project-refuses on oi8z.figured where the candidate computes the entered amount (classm.dependent.3: kind other, candidate $6,999.00; stage16.refuse.oi8z.figured: $2,300.00; generated 0, 28, 39, 50). Project stands.

Ruling: equivalent; project retained. Line 8b is a copy of the gambling winnings input (s1.line8b, from s1.gambling_winnings; i1040gi p. 91, Line 8b, "Enter gambling winnings not attributable to a trade or business"), so winnings above zero and line 8b above zero are the same test; the comparison does not expand the same form's line inside a helper.
